name: config-schema-array-cardinality
description: A ConfigPropertySchema of type 'array' carries the JSON Schema cardinality keywords `minItems` and `maxItems` alongside its `items` schema, reaching every client through SessionModelInfo.configSchema on a root/agentsChanged action. Both fields are optional integers, so this pins their presence and value through a decode/re-encode cycle — without it, a per-language serialization regression on the new fields would leave the rest of the corpus green. `minItems: 0` is included deliberately: it must survive rather than being dropped as a falsy default.
